signed_rows.behavior: kmaudit builds its install hint from its installed version: a release or pre-release version names its kmaudit-vX.Y.Z tag with #subdirectory=packages/kmaudit, a dev or local version names no ref, and extras go in the requirement, so the tracing refusal asks for kmaudit[tracing]; steps.py, judge.py, check_verbs.py and ui.py use it.
signed_rows.fails_when: a release version's hint lacks its tag, a dev version's names one, the tracing refusal leaves out the extra, or a hand-written INSTALL string remains

signed_rows.behavior: release.py set --package kmaudit pins kmaudit's README install line and the tracing line in packages/kmaudit/docs/commands.md to the release tag, and refuses, writing nothing, when either line is missing; the Release run's kmaudit bump stages docs/commands.md.
signed_rows.fails_when: either line keeps an old ref, a missing line is not refused or something is written anyway, or the bump leaves docs/commands.md out
signed_rows.command: uv run pytest tests/scripts/test_release.py tests/scripts/test_workflows.py -k kmaudit -q
